entities.name: Fmoc-L-leucine
observations: Carboxylic-acid coupling partner; its Fmoc protecting group is retained during amidation.

entities.name: Aminoalkyl boronic ester
observations: Primary amine coupling partner bearing a boronic ester and tert-butyl ester; these groups are predicted to remain intact.
The supplied representation does not establish stereochemistry at the aminoalkyl-boronate center.

entities.name: Isobutyl chloroformate
observations: Carboxyl-activating reagent used to form a mixed anhydride.

entities.name: N-Methylmorpholine
observations: Base that promotes mixed-anhydride formation and neutralizes HCl.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: Solvent; not incorporated into the product.

entities.name: Fmoc-leucine amidation
observations: Mixed-anhydride peptide coupling between Fmoc-L-leucine and the aminoalkyl boronic ester gives the corresponding carboxamide.

entities.name: Major amide product
observations: New connectivity is Fmoc-L-Leu-C(O)-NH-CH(CH2CH3)-B(pin), with the aminoalkyl substrate's tert-butyl ester and boronic ester retained.
